detail_question: Is it on a council wall or a private building?
example_phrases: graffiti on the wall by the bus stop
posters stuck on every lamp post

facts.caveat: This is an aim, not a guarantee.
facts.fact: The council aims to deal with over 75% of urgent street cleaning requests within one working day of report.
Graffiti and fly-posting will also be investigated by the council.

On public land the council's specialist reactive team removes graffiti and fly-posting. Street cleansing teams and Neighbourhood Wardens use graffiti wipes on small graffiti, and the council issues wipes to local individuals and groups.

facts.caveat: The cost of a quote is not stated.
facts.fact: The council does not fund or resource graffiti removal on private or commercial property as a core service. It can advise owners, and owners or businesses can request help from the specialist team through a form that leads to a request for a quote.

facts.caveat: The page states these under public land reporting.
facts.fact: The council aims to remove racist, obscene or hate crime graffiti within one working day of a report and other graffiti within two weeks.

facts.caveat: Confirmed for graffiti on this equipment only, not for general faults.
facts.fact: Graffiti on BT or Openreach street cabinets should be reported to Openreach on 0800 023 2023 and on Virgin Media cabinets to Virgin Media on 0330 333 0444. Graffiti on bus shelters or railway bridges should be reported to the company responsible, not the council.
Hate/obscene graffiti aimed within 1 working day, other graffiti within 2 weeks. Private/commercial graffiti not in core service.

form_notes: Private/commercial property not in core service; advise police report (criminal damage). Hate/obscene graffiti is aimed within 1 working day.
